description: Manage lease renewals from expiration identification through execution of the new lease.

steps.description: Identify leases approaching expiration and flag them for renewal action.

inputs.name: lease-portfolio
inputs.desc: All active leases with terms and dates

inputs.name: lead-time-days
inputs.desc: Number of days before expiration to start the renewal process

outputs.name: expiring-leases
outputs.desc: Leases due for renewal within the lead time

outputs.name: tenant-history
outputs.desc: Payment and compliance history for each expiring tenant

process: Pull all leases with expiration dates within the lead time window.
Flag each lease with tenant payment history and violation records.
Rank by priority: month-to-month conversions first, then by unit value.

steps.description: Assess current market rent for the unit to inform renewal pricing.

outputs.name: market-rent-estimates
outputs.desc: Market rent for each unit based on comparables

outputs.name: renewal-pricing-recommendations
outputs.desc: Recommended rent and terms for each renewal

process: Collect comparable listings for each unit by size, location, and amenities.
Calculate the market rent range from the comparables.
Factor in tenant quality and vacancy cost to set the renewal price.

steps.description: Prepare the renewal offer letter with proposed terms.

outputs.name: renewal-offers
outputs.desc: Draft renewal offer letters for each tenant

outputs.name: offer-terms-summary
outputs.desc: Summary of proposed terms per unit

process: Draft the renewal letter with the new rent, lease term, and any changed conditions.
Include a response deadline and instructions for acceptance.
Attach a comparison showing the current vs. proposed terms.

steps.description: Track negotiations with tenants on renewal terms.

outputs.name: negotiation-log
outputs.desc: Record of all communications and counteroffers

outputs.name: agreed-terms
outputs.desc: Final agreed renewal terms per tenant

process: Send the renewal offer and log the delivery date.
Record each counteroffer and response with dates.
Document the final agreed terms or the decision to vacate.

steps.description: Execute the new lease and update records.

outputs.name: executed-leases
outputs.desc: Signed lease documents

outputs.name: renewal-record
outputs.desc: Complete renewal record with all supporting documents

process: Generate the new lease document with the agreed terms.
Collect signatures from tenant and landlord.
Update the property management system with the new lease dates and rent.
File the executed lease and produce the renewal record.

description: Manage monthly rent collection from invoicing through reconciliation.

steps.description: Generate monthly rent invoices for all tenants.

inputs.name: lease-portfolio
inputs.desc: Active leases with rent amounts and due dates

outputs.name: rent-invoices
outputs.desc: Generated invoices for each tenant

outputs.name: expected-revenue
outputs.desc: Total expected rent revenue for the period

process: Pull active leases and their rent amounts for the billing period.
Generate an invoice for each tenant with the amount due, due date, and payment instructions.
Calculate the total expected revenue for the period.

steps.description: Track payment status and identify delinquent accounts.

outputs.name: payment-ledger
outputs.desc: Status of each invoice: paid, pending, overdue

outputs.name: delinquent-accounts
outputs.desc: Accounts past due with days outstanding

process: Match incoming payments against open invoices.
Update the ledger with payment dates and amounts.
Flag accounts past the due date as delinquent.

steps.description: Send payment reminders on a scheduled cadence.

inputs.name: payment-ledger
inputs.desc: Current payment status for all tenants

outputs.name: reminder-log
outputs.desc: Record of all reminders sent with dates

outputs.name: late-fee-assessments
outputs.desc: Late fees applied per lease terms

process: Send courtesy reminders 3 days before the due date.
Send past-due notices on the day after the due date.
Apply late fees per the lease terms and notify the tenant.
Escalate accounts past 30 days to collections.

steps.description: Reconcile payments and produce the collection report.

outputs.name: reconciliation-report
outputs.desc: Reconciled rent collection report for the period

outputs.name: collection-metrics
outputs.desc: Collection rate, average days to pay, delinquency rate

process: Reconcile all payments against invoices and late fees.
Calculate collection metrics: rate, average days to pay, delinquency rate.
Produce the period collection report with variance analysis.

description: Dispatch and track maintenance requests from receipt through completion.

steps.description: Receive and classify a maintenance work order from a tenant.

inputs.name: tenant-request
inputs.desc: Maintenance request from the tenant with description and photos

outputs.name: work-order
outputs.desc: Classified work order with urgency level

outputs.name: urgency-classification
outputs.desc: Emergency, urgent, or routine classification

process: Record the tenant request with unit number, description, and photos.
Classify by urgency: emergency (safety, flooding), urgent (no heat, no water), routine (cosmetic, minor).
Assign a work order number and notify the tenant of receipt.

steps.description: Assign the work order to a maintenance tech or vendor and schedule the visit.

outputs.name: assignment-record
outputs.desc: Tech or vendor assigned with scheduled date

outputs.name: tenant-notification
outputs.desc: Notification sent to the tenant with the scheduled visit

process: Match the work type to available techs or vendors.
Schedule based on urgency: emergency same-day, urgent within 24 hours, routine within 5 business days.
Notify the tenant of the assigned tech and scheduled date.

steps.description: Track work completion and follow up with the tenant.

outputs.name: completion-record
outputs.desc: Work completed with tech notes and photos

outputs.name: maintenance-log
outputs.desc: Full maintenance log entry for the property

process: Confirm the tech completed the visit and collect completion notes.
Record parts used, labor hours, and before/after photos.
Follow up with the tenant within 48 hours to confirm satisfaction.
Close the work order and update the property maintenance log.

description: Coordinate property showings for a vacant unit from listing through prospect follow-up.

steps.description: List the vacant unit on rental platforms.

inputs.name: unit-details
inputs.desc: Unit specifications, photos, and rent amount

outputs.name: active-listings
outputs.desc: Published listings with URLs

outputs.name: listing-analytics
outputs.desc: Initial view and inquiry counts

process: Prepare the listing with photos, floor plan, rent, and move-in requirements.
Publish to each target platform.
Verify the listing is active and accurate on each platform.

steps.description: Screen incoming showing requests and schedule appointments.

outputs.name: showing-schedule
outputs.desc: Scheduled showing appointments

outputs.name: prospect-profiles
outputs.desc: Basic information on each prospective tenant

process: Collect prospect inquiries from all platforms.
Pre-screen prospects for basic eligibility (income, move-in date, pets).
Schedule showings in time blocks to maximize efficiency.

steps.description: Conduct the showing and collect prospect feedback.

outputs.name: showing-notes
outputs.desc: Notes from each showing including prospect interest level

outputs.name: showing-activity-log
outputs.desc: Complete log of all showings conducted

process: Prepare the unit for showing: clean, lights on, temperature set.
Conduct the showing and answer prospect questions.
Rate each prospect's interest level and collect their feedback.
Follow up with interested prospects within 24 hours.

description: Process a new tenant move-in from lease verification through orientation.

steps.description: Verify all prerequisites are met before the tenant moves in.

outputs.name: readiness-checklist
outputs.desc: Verified checklist of all move-in prerequisites

outputs.name: outstanding-items
outputs.desc: Any items still needed before move-in

process: Confirm the lease is fully executed and all deposits collected.
Verify renter's insurance is on file.
Confirm the unit is move-in ready: cleaned, repaired, and inspected.

steps.description: Complete the move-in condition report with photos.

outputs.name: condition-report
outputs.desc: Documented condition of every room with photos

outputs.name: key-handoff-record
outputs.desc: Keys and access credentials provided to the tenant

process: Walk through every room and document the condition with photos.
Note any existing damage or wear.
Have the tenant sign the condition report.
Hand over keys, fobs, and access credentials.

steps.description: Orient the new tenant to the property and produce the move-in checklist.

outputs.name: orientation-confirmation
outputs.desc: Confirmation that the tenant received the orientation

outputs.name: move-in-checklist
outputs.desc: Completed move-in checklist with all items signed off

process: Walk the tenant through property rules, trash, parking, and emergency contacts.
Set up utility transfers and confirm the forwarding address.
Confirm the tenant has all necessary information and produce the move-in checklist.

description: Process a tenant move-out from inspection through deposit return.

steps.description: Schedule and prepare for the move-out inspection.

inputs.name: move-out-notice
inputs.desc: Tenant's notice to vacate with move-out date

outputs.name: inspection-appointment
outputs.desc: Scheduled inspection date and time

outputs.name: comparison-checklist
outputs.desc: Room-by-room checklist referencing the move-in report

process: Schedule the walk-through inspection with the tenant.
Prepare the comparison checklist from the original move-in condition report.
Confirm the appointment with the tenant.

steps.description: Conduct the walk-through and assess damage beyond normal wear.

outputs.name: damage-report
outputs.desc: Itemized damage report with photos and repair cost estimates

outputs.name: deposit-deduction-worksheet
outputs.desc: Deductions itemized with amounts and justification

process: Walk each room and compare against the move-in condition report.
Document damage beyond normal wear with photos.
Estimate repair costs for each item.
Prepare the deposit deduction worksheet.

steps.description: Process the security deposit return and prepare the unit for turnover.

outputs.name: deposit-return-record
outputs.desc: Record of deposit returned with itemized deductions

outputs.name: move-out-record
outputs.desc: Complete move-out file with all supporting documents

process: Calculate the net deposit return amount.
Send the itemized statement and deposit return within the statutory deadline.
Schedule turnover work: cleaning, painting, and repairs.
Close the tenant file and produce the move-out record.

description: Produce monthly property financial reports from data collection through owner distribution.

steps.description: Collect all income and expense data for the reporting period.

inputs.name: reporting-period
inputs.desc: Month and year for the report

outputs.name: income-data
outputs.desc: All income by category: rent, late fees, other

outputs.name: expense-data
outputs.desc: All expenses by category: maintenance, insurance, taxes, management fees

process: Pull all income records for the period: rent collected, late fees, application fees, other.
Pull all expense records: maintenance, insurance, property taxes, management fees, utilities.
Verify all transactions are properly categorized.

steps.description: Reconcile the property operating account.

outputs.name: reconciled-balance
outputs.desc: Reconciled bank balance with book balance

outputs.name: reconciliation-adjustments
outputs.desc: Any adjustments identified during reconciliation

process: Compare the bank statement against the book records.
Identify and resolve discrepancies.
Record any adjustments needed.

steps.description: Calculate NOI and cash flow and compare against budget.

outputs.name: financial-statements
outputs.desc: P&L, NOI, and cash flow statement

outputs.name: budget-variance-analysis
outputs.desc: Actuals vs budget by line item

process: Calculate gross income, operating expenses, and NOI.
Calculate cash flow after debt service.
Compare each line item against the budget and note variances.

steps.description: Prepare the owner distribution and produce the monthly financial report.

outputs.name: owner-distribution
outputs.desc: Distribution amount and supporting calculation

outputs.name: monthly-financial-report
outputs.desc: Complete monthly financial report package

process: Calculate the owner distribution based on cash flow and reserve requirements.
Prepare the distribution check or wire.
Package the financial statements, variance analysis, and distribution into the monthly report.

description: Analyze the rental market to set or adjust rent pricing.

steps.description: Collect comparable rental listings from the market.

inputs.name: search-criteria
inputs.desc: Geographic radius, unit type, and size range

outputs.name: comparable-listings
outputs.desc: Comparable rentals with rent, size, amenities, and age

outputs.name: market-snapshot
outputs.desc: Summary of current market conditions: vacancy rate, average rent, trend

process: Search rental platforms for listings matching the criteria.
Record rent, size, amenities, age, and days on market for each comparable.
Calculate the market vacancy rate and average rent for the area.

steps.description: Adjust comparables for differences and calculate market rent.

outputs.name: adjusted-comps
outputs.desc: Comparables adjusted for differences in size, amenities, condition

outputs.name: market-rent-range
outputs.desc: Calculated market rent range per unit

process: Adjust each comparable for differences in size, condition, amenities, and location.
Calculate the adjusted rent per square foot for each comparable.
Determine the market rent range from the adjusted comparables.

steps.description: Compare current rents against market and recommend adjustments.

outputs.name: pricing-recommendations
outputs.desc: Recommended rent for each unit with justification

outputs.name: market-analysis-report
outputs.desc: Complete rental market analysis report

process: Compare each unit's current rent against the market range.
Identify units priced above or below market.
Recommend specific rent adjustments with timing.
Produce the market analysis report with supporting data.

description: Review property insurance coverage for adequacy and cost.

steps.description: Inventory all covered properties and their current coverage.

inputs.name: property-portfolio
inputs.desc: All properties with addresses and values

inputs.name: current-policies
inputs.desc: Active insurance policies with coverage details

outputs.name: coverage-inventory
outputs.desc: Each property with its coverage type, limits, and premium

outputs.name: coverage-gaps
outputs.desc: Properties or risks without adequate coverage

process: List each property with its insured value, coverage type, and limits.
Compare coverage against replacement cost estimates.
Identify gaps: insufficient limits, missing coverages, or excluded perils.

steps.description: Assess flood, catastrophe, and liability exposure.

outputs.name: risk-assessment
outputs.desc: Risk exposure by property and peril type

outputs.name: coverage-recommendations
outputs.desc: Recommended changes to coverage

process: Assess each property for flood zone, earthquake, and windstorm exposure.
Review liability limits against the number of units and tenant activity.
Recommend coverage changes to close identified gaps.

steps.description: Solicit competitive quotes and produce the insurance review report.

outputs.name: competitive-quotes
outputs.desc: Quotes from multiple carriers with comparison

outputs.name: insurance-review-report
outputs.desc: Complete insurance review with recommendations

process: Send the coverage specifications to at least three carriers.
Compare quotes on premium, deductibles, exclusions, and carrier financial strength.
Recommend the carrier and produce the insurance review report.

description: Manage HOA violations from receipt through resolution.

steps.description: Review the violation notice and assess the property for compliance.

inputs.name: violation-notice
inputs.desc: HOA violation notice with cited rule and deadline

outputs.name: violation-assessment
outputs.desc: Assessment of whether the violation is valid and what correction is needed

outputs.name: remediation-options
outputs.desc: Options for resolving the violation with cost and timeline

process: Read the violation notice and identify the cited rule.
Inspect the property to confirm or dispute the violation.
List remediation options with estimated cost and timeline.

steps.description: Execute the corrections and document the resolution.

outputs.name: correction-record
outputs.desc: Documentation of corrections made with before and after photos

outputs.name: remediation-cost
outputs.desc: Actual cost of the remediation

process: Select the remediation approach and schedule the work.
Execute the corrections and document with photos.
Record the actual cost and completion date.

steps.description: Respond to the HOA and produce the violation resolution record.

outputs.name: hoa-response
outputs.desc: Response filed with the HOA including photos

outputs.name: violation-resolution-record
outputs.desc: Complete file for the violation from notice through resolution

process: Draft the response to the HOA with before and after photos.
Submit the response before the deadline.
File the complete record: notice, assessment, corrections, response, and resolution confirmation.
